OOC: You’re right—Ysolde had no basis to know what the lawyers selected. Retconning that to her noticing the repairs and ink, then asking what you did before they found you.

Ysolde glances at your stained fingers. “A scribe. That explains the ink.”

“It also explains the coat,” Thessaly says. “Books do not generally pay well.”

“They sometimes pay very well,” Caelindra says. “Just not to the person copying them.”

Rashid lets out a quiet breath through his nose. “What sort of library?”

Caelindra’s eyes shift to you over her spoon. “And what did they trust an apprentice to copy?”
